# UI Requirements Quality Checklist: Variable Card Value Field Without Scrollbars

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements — sizing/overflow, scrollbar settings and zoom,
accessibility of the value box, regression safety for the shared hook's other consumer, and the
split between jsdom-testable rules and by-eye checks. Audience: PR reviewer; depth: standard.
**Created**: 2026-10-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`, then run against the spec: every item was evaluated;
the three that failed on the first run (CHK011, CHK012, CHK024) were fixed in `spec.md` before
being ticked.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Is the maximum height of the value box quantified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §FR-006] — 6 lines of text.
- [x] CHK002 - Are horizontal and vertical overflow specified separately? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-002] — never sideways; vertical only past 6 lines.
- [x] CHK003 - Is the content that determines an empty box's height defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003] — the placeholder; one line.
- [x] CHK004 - Are requirements defined for every form of the card, including the one without a box? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008] — undefined, defined, secret; locked secret unchanged.
- [x] CHK005 - Are shrink-on-delete and first-paint sizing both specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK006 - Are the requirements for the shared behaviour's other consumer (variable table cells) stated, including what must not change? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012, §SC-006]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 - Is "fully visible placeholder" backed by measurable facts rather than a judgment call? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, §FR-007] — 37 characters against 39 that fit; zoom scales both.
- [x] CHK008 - Is the wrapping rule for text with no break opportunities explicit? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, Edge Cases] — breaks inside the word.
- [x] CHK009 - Is "the height fits its content" defined without reference to an estimate? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005] — measured from the laid-out content at the current width.
- [x] CHK010 - Is the boundary case "exactly 6 lines" unambiguous (no scrollbar)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002] — "fits in 6 lines" → no vertical scrollbar; plan R3 adds the 1 px rounding tolerance.

## Non-Functional: Accessibility & Interaction

- [x] CHK011 - Do the requirements preserve the box's accessible name, focus ring and placeholder texts? [Accessibility, Spec §FR-009] — fixed: FR-009 now lists them as unchanged.
- [x] CHK012 - Is keyboard access to content beyond the 6-line cap specified? [Accessibility, Spec §FR-006] — fixed: FR-006 now requires caret movement to keep the caret's line in view.
- [x] CHK013 - Are motion requirements needed for height changes? [Accessibility] — not applicable: the box resizes instantly, with no animation, so reduced-motion has nothing to govern.
- [x] CHK014 - Are localization or right-to-left requirements needed? [Coverage] — not applicable: the PRD defines an English-only UI and the placeholders are fixed English strings.
- [x] CHK015 - Are theme or contrast requirements affected? [Coverage] — not applicable: the fix removes scrollbars and changes no colours; the theme is dark only (constitution VI).

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK016 - Do SC-001's zoom levels match User Story 3's independent test and the by-eye procedure? [Consistency, Spec §SC-001, US3; quickstart §3] — 67 / 100 / 200% in all three (fixed during analyze).
- [x] CHK017 - Is the same 6-line cap used everywhere the card is described? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003/§FR-006, plan Design, data-model] — 6 throughout; the table cell is explicitly uncapped.
- [x] CHK018 - Is the terminology consistent? [Consistency] — "value box" throughout; the title keeps the issue's "value field" wording on purpose.

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK019 - Are scrollbar settings in scope enumerated? [Coverage, Spec US3] — macOS "Always" and "when scrolling", and Windows/Linux permanent scrollbars.
- [x] CHK020 - Are the saving/disabled state, values changed from outside, multi-line pastes and the locked secret covered? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK021 - Is the card-width assumption documented and validated against the window's minimum size? [Assumption, Spec §Edge Cases "Narrow window", §Assumptions] — 960 px minimum window (480 CSS px at 200%) > 336 px.
- [x] CHK022 - Can sizing ever reveal anything about a secret's value? [Security, Spec US2 scenario 3; plan Constitution II] — no: a secret's value is never in the box, only its placeholder.

## Acceptance Criteria & Verification

- [x] CHK023 - Is it explicit which rules are verified by unit tests and which only by eye? [Measurability, Spec §FR-010, §FR-011] — rules by test (layout faked), appearance by eye.
- [x] CHK024 - Is the verification scope for platforms not checked by eye documented with a rationale? [Gap → fixed, Spec §Assumptions] — Windows/Linux are covered by the platform-independent rules and the CI matrix in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`.
- [x] CHK025 - Is the by-eye procedure repeatable (setting, build, steps, evidence, restoring the setting)? [Measurability, Spec §Assumptions; quickstart §3] — includes the screenshot requirement and restoring the setting.
- [x] CHK026 - Is a regression bar defined for existing card and table behaviour? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-005, §SC-006] — the existing tests must pass unchanged.

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK027 - Are the fixed design metrics the requirements rely on (320 px card, 12 px monospace text) stated as assumptions? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK028 - Is "frontend only, no Go change" stated and consistent with the plan's structure? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions; plan Project Structure]
- [x] CHK029 - Is a per-keystroke performance expectation stated? [Non-Functional, plan Technical Context] — one reflow per fit, before paint; a 6-line box has no meaningful cost beyond that.
